section.content: 本发明涉及一种锂离子电池，具体涉及一种移动电源用高安全快充型锂离子电池，属于锂离子电池材料领域。本发明锂离子电池包括正极、负极、隔膜、电解液及电池外壳，所述正极包括集流体以及涂覆在集流体表面的正极材料，所述正极材料中的正极活性物质为NCM811和锰酸锂的混合物，且两者的份数比为(2‑3)：1。本发明采取NCM811与锰酸锂材料复合使用，利用NCM811优异的循环、高温、高克容量及压实结合锰酸锂高的电压平台及优异的低温、倍率及加工性能，降低移动电源成本，延长其使用寿命，提升其快充性能。

The invention relates to a lithium ion battery, in particular to a high-safety quick-charging lithium ion battery for a mobile power supply, and belongs to the field of lithium ion battery materials. The lithium ion battery comprises a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a diaphragm, electrolyte and a battery shell, wherein the positive electrode comprises a current collector and a positive electrode material coated on the surface of the current collector, a positive electrode active substance in the positive electrode material is a mixture of NCM811 and lithium manganate, and the part ratio of the NCM811 to the lithium manganate is (2-3): 1. according to the invention, NCM811 and the lithium manganate material are used in a composite manner, and the excellent cycle, high temperature and high gram capacity of NCM811, and the high voltage platform of lithium manganate and the excellent low temperature, rate and processing performance are combined in a compaction manner, so that the cost of the mobile power supply is reduced, the service life of the mobile power supply is prolonged, and the quick charging performance of the mobile power supply is improved.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to a lithium ion battery, in particular to a high-safety quick-charging lithium ion battery for a mobile power supply, and belongs to the field of lithium ion battery materials.

Background

Since 2016 for the next half year, the price of metallic cobalt has continued to rise from 20 ten thousand per ton to 60 ten thousand yuan per ton, and the industry-approved MB cobalt offers have risen from $ 13/pound to $ 38/pound, with the rising range being as high as 200%, which has brought a tremendous cost pressure on downstream battery manufacturers, especially in the field of mobile power supply applications, which is extremely price sensitive, pursuing high energy density and fast charge performance, and demanding on the selection and rational use of material systems. The layered high-nickel ternary 811 is a preferred anode material for next-generation high-energy-density low-cost batteries due to high specific capacity and low cobalt content, but the layered high-nickel ternary 811 has the problems of swelling in the later period of long-term circulation, particularly high-temperature circulation, is temporarily in the test stage in the field of power batteries and is not applied in large batch due to the complex manufacturing process, high environmental requirement and easy moisture absorption of materials. The spinel lithium manganate has lower cost, better safety performance, simpler processing performance and a discharge platform as high as 3.8V, but the energy density is not high due to low compaction density and gram volume, so that the large-scale application of the spinel lithium manganate is limited.

Disclosure of Invention

Aiming at the problems in the prior art, the invention provides the lithium ion battery for the digital mobile power supply, which has the advantages of high energy density, excellent high and low temperature performance, long cycle life, excellent quick charge performance, outstanding safety performance and low cost.

The purpose of the invention is realized by the following technical scheme: the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, lithium ion battery includes positive pole, negative pole, diaphragm, electrolyte and battery case, the positive pole includes the mass flow body and coats the cathode material on the mass flow body surface, cathode active material in the cathode material is the mixture of NCM811 and lithium manganate, and the part ratio of both is (2-3): 1.

According to the invention, the NCM811 and the lithium manganate material are used in a composite manner, and the lithium ion battery for the digital mobile power supply, which has high energy density, excellent high-low temperature performance, long cycle life, excellent quick charge performance, outstanding safety performance and low cost, is developed by utilizing excellent cycle, high-temperature and high gram capacity of the NCM811 and compaction combined with a high voltage platform of lithium manganate and excellent low temperature, multiplying power and processing performance, so that the high-voltage 523 and lithium cobaltate mobile power supply which is mainstream at present is replaced, the cost of the mobile power supply is reduced, the service life of the mobile power supply is prolonged, and the quick charge performance of the mobile power supply is.

In the lithium ion battery, the NCM811 is an NCM811 coated with an N-doped nanocellulose composite material. The preparation method of the NCM811 comprises the following steps: NiSO is weighed according to the molar ratio of 8:14·6H2O、CoSO4·7H2O and MnSO4·H2And O, adding NaOH solution to perform coprecipitation reaction, adjusting the pH value, performing vacuum filtration, washing and drying, adding N-doped nano-cellulose, mixing, performing ball milling treatment for 6-7h to obtain precursor slurry, drying, grinding and calcining to obtain the N-doped nano-cellulose coated NCM 8111.

Preferably, the mass of the N-doped nanocellulose composite is 0.12-0.14% of the mass of NCM 811.

Preferably, the doping amount of N in the N-doped nano-cellulose composite material is 0.15-0.17% of the composite material. The compound contains pi electrons which can be delocalized in molecules, and simultaneously, a carbon skeleton is easy to replace so as to adjust the electrical characteristics of the compound. The nano-cellulose has different structural forms, particularly three-dimensional network porous structures with different microscale, and inorganic or organic nano-materials with various micro-nanoscale can be diffused or filled in the nano-cellulose so as to improve the specific surface area of the nano-cellulose. The original characteristics of the nano-cellulose such as high water absorption, swelling property, biocompatibility and the like are mutually fused with the specific photoelectric properties of various inorganic or organic nano-materials, so that the conductive composite material with special functions, such as high conductivity, photoelectric conversion property and electrochemical redox property, which is the conductive composite material can be obtained, has abundant porosity and three-dimensional network structure, and has uniform particle distribution and no large-area accumulation.

Preferably, the preparation method of the N-doped nano-cellulose comprises the following steps: mixing nano-cellulose and bithiophene in deionized water, heating and refluxing for 6-7h at 60-80 ℃, performing suction filtration, cleaning and suction filtration by using deionized water, drying the solid obtained by suction filtration for 8-9 h at 80-100 ℃, preparing bithiophene-coated nano-cellulose by an in-situ chemical polymerization method, performing heat treatment on the bithiophene-coated nano-cellulose in high-purity nitrogen atmosphere, and converting the bithiophene layer into a nitrogen-doped layer, thereby preparing the N-doped coated nano-cellulose.

In the above lithium ion battery, the lithium manganate is Co2And the lithium manganate is coated by the P/porous carbon composite material. The preparation method of the lithium manganate comprises the following steps: according to the molar ratio of (1-2): 1 weighing lithium acetate and manganese acetate, stirring for dissolving, adding citric acid monohydrate, stirring to form sol, heating for evaporating to form gel, presintering, cooling, and adding Co2Mixing the P/porous carbon composite material, performing ball milling treatment for 6-7h to obtain precursor slurry, drying, grinding and calcining to obtain Co2And the lithium manganate is coated by the P/porous carbon composite material.

The metal organic framework compound (MOFs) is a novel porous crystal material, and has a changeable framework structure and easily functionalized pore channels, and the carbon-containing nano material prepared by carbonizing by taking the MOFs as a template has the advantages of high specific surface area, high crystallinity, changeable framework structure, adjustable morphology and the like, various nano materials can be synthesized by selecting the proper MOFs template and pyrolysis atmosphere and temperature, and in the carbonization process, carbon converted by an organic ligand is wrapped around metal nano particles to prevent the metal nano particles from further agglomerating, so that the nano particles are more uniformly and stably dispersed in the porous carbon matrix by the in-situ preparation method.

Preferably, the Co is2The mass of the P/porous carbon composite material is 0.18-0.27% of that of the lithium manganate. The Co2The preparation method of the P/porous carbon composite material comprises the following steps: tetraethyl p-xylene diphosphate and Co (NO)3)2·6H2And mixing O, reacting, cooling, filtering under reduced pressure, washing, drying, heating in a carbonization furnace, and reacting while keeping the temperature. Co2The P particles are uniformly dispersed in the porous carbon matrix, and no obvious agglomeration exists among the particles, and the P particles and the Co particles are uniformly dispersed in the porous carbon matrix2The carbon with the P particles closely connected is strip-shaped and is graphitized carbon, and the graphitized carbon coats Co2The composite structure of P particles effectively prevents Co2The P particles are agglomerated in the carbonization process, and ensureGood cycling stability during electrochemical testing.

Preferably, the tetraethyl-p-xylylene diphosphate and Co (NO)3)2·6H2The molar ratio of O is (1-1.5): 1. the temperature rise process in the carbonization furnace is 5-10 ℃/min, the heat preservation temperature is 80-90 ℃, and the heat preservation time is 2-3 h.

Preferably, the Co is2Co in P/porous carbon composite material2Mass ratio of P to porous carbon (2-4): 1.

preferably, the current collector is a carbon-coated aluminum foil current collector, and the thickness of the carbon-coated aluminum foil current collector is 12-14 μm. The aluminum foil current collector has good conductivity and soft texture, a layer of oxide film can be formed on the surface, and the aluminum foil oxide layer is very compact due to high anode potential, so that the current collector can be prevented from being oxidized.

In the lithium ion battery, the diaphragm is a PAN-PVDF composite nanofiber membrane. The PAN-PVDF composite nanofiber membrane is adopted, so that the porosity, the fiber diameter and the pore diameter of the membrane can be effectively changed, and the mechanical property is good; the PAN-PVDF composite nanofiber membrane is dense in quality and small in pore size, and points are bonded among fibers, so that the excellent performance of the electrostatic spinning membrane is reserved, and the PAN-PVDF composite nanofiber membrane has extremely high porosity, liquid absorption rate and air permeability.

In the above lithium ion battery, in the above method for preparing a lithium ion battery, the electrolyte specifically includes the following components: solutes, solvents and additives. The solvent is one or more of ethylene carbonate, diethyl carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; the solute is lithium salt, and can be halide, sulfate, nitrate or oxalate of lithium; the additive is Li2CO3Such that Li2CO3The Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI) film on the surface of the electrode has stronger viscoelasticity and can better adapt to the tiny change of the particle volume in the lithium ion intercalation process, thereby enabling the intercalation process of the lithium ions to be easier to carry out.

In the lithium ion battery, the parts of the components in the positive electrode are as follows: positive electrode active material: 85-90 parts of a conductive agent: 2-5 parts, PAA binder: 5-10 parts, PEG: 50-60 parts.

Preferably, the conductive agent is a mixture of carbon nanotubes and ultrafine carbon powder, and the mass ratio of the conductive agent to the ultrafine carbon powder is 1-2: 1. The invention utilizes the synergistic effect among different carbon conductive agents to improve the conductivity of the pole piece, reduce the internal resistance of the battery and improve the electrochemical performance of the battery.

The invention also aims to provide a preparation method of the lithium ion battery, which comprises the following steps:

preparing a positive electrode: dissolving a PAA binder into a PEG solvent, adding a positive active substance and a conductive agent, mixing in an agate tank, placing in a planetary ball mill, stirring and mixing to obtain a positive slurry, coating the positive slurry on a carbon-coated aluminum foil current collector by using a coating machine, performing vacuum drying to volatilize PEG, rolling and slitting the coated electrode, and performing vacuum drying to obtain a lithium ion battery positive plate;

preparing a negative electrode: mixing and stirring the negative active substance, the negative conductive agent, the negative adhesive and the negative solvent uniformly to prepare negative slurry, and coating the negative slurry on a negative current collector to prepare a negative plate;

assembling: and (4) placing the positive plate, the diaphragm and the negative plate into a battery shell, and sealing the battery core after injecting the electrolyte to obtain the lithium ion battery.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages:

1. according to the invention, NCM811 and the lithium manganate material are used in a composite manner, and the excellent cycle, high temperature and high gram capacity of NCM811, and the high voltage platform of lithium manganate and excellent low temperature, rate and processing performance are combined in a compaction manner, so that the cost of the mobile power supply is reduced, the service life of the mobile power supply is prolonged, and the quick charging performance of the mobile power supply is improved;

2. the NCM811 is coated by the N-doped nano-cellulose composite material, so that the special functional material conductive composite material with high conductivity, photoelectric conversion performance and electrochemical redox characteristics can be obtained, has rich porosity and three-dimensional network structure, is uniform in particle distribution, and does not have large-area accumulation;

3. the lithium manganate of the invention is Co2The in-situ preparation method of the P/porous carbon composite material-coated lithium manganate also enables the nano particles to be more uniformly and stably dispersed in the porous carbon matrix.
